loadout_known_id.note: Index is discovery only. Standard is formation-level; issue/custody stays in state.

command_capacity.note: Load commander plus direct reporting formations/subordinate command nodes. One shared personnel/slot budget regardless of ownership.

mass_battle.note: Load real participating formations and compact battle kernels first; wake detailed capability only on material asymmetry/close thresholds.

institutional_role_slot.note: Load the known institution's role-slot registry only when an unmaterialized office, vacancy, succession, appointment continuity or officeholder materialization is causally relevant. Role slots are institutional continuity, not hidden characters.

formation.note: Templates are reusable data. Active formation exists only inside a mapped mission/operation/state owner when instantiated and owns no manpower.

equipment.note: Known loadout ID uses direct path template in loadout_known_id; index only for discovery.

formation_deployment.note: Only after an active operation/battle has instantiated explicit formations/command nodes.

command_group.note: Command-only node, owns no manpower. Parent counts one slot; descendants load on subordinate.

command_tree.note: Load root commander and only directly referenced formations/people/groups; recurse only as far as needed. Do not load unrelated armies.

combat_operations.note: Bounded operational commitments. Source force retains manpower ownership; operation owns temporary committed-formation condition and battle result.

formations.note: Bounded aggregate formations and force commitments. Named consequential people remain person owners.

formation_refit.note: Load target formation, exact loadout record, inventory/issue owners. Target standard does not instantly issue gear.

formation_development.note: Load formation + training profile + capability refs only as needed; rebuild kernel after authoritative capability changes.

formation_split_merge.note: Split or merge aggregate formations deterministically. Conserve personnel, named-member claims, equipment, injuries, experience and history through the normal semantic transaction receipt.
